newsitem.title: CANADA: BHP Arctic mine getting regulatory approval.
newsitem.headline: BHP Arctic mine getting regulatory approval.

text.p: The Canadian government said on Tuesday the proposed BHP diamond mine for the Northwest Territories was undergoing the final regulatory steps.

Northern Development Minister Ronald Irwin said in a statement that the environmental agreement and water license for the project had been signed and that six 30-year land leases were being issued. The company involved is BHP Diamond Inc, a joint venture between Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd and Dia Met Minerals Ltd. Final federal approval was granted for the C$860 million project on November 1, "subject to the normal regulatory process."
